From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Planned: regional GPU firmware sweep & rolling restarts (Jun 4-6)

Team,

We're preparing a controlled firmware sweep and staged driver restarts for our US-West regions to address an intermittent GPU microcode hang that showed up in recent telemetry. Goal is to complete the sweep with minimal customer impact and no loss of cached KV state. High level: 

- Scope: US-West3 (primary), with targeted canary waves in US-West1 and US-West2 if canaries look healthy.
- Window: 2027-06-04 23:00 UTC -> 2027-06-06 06:00 UTC (rolling across AZs; each AZ ~30-45m).
- Impact: short rolling restarts per instance (expected 30-90s recovery for individual containers). No mass evictions planned.
- Safety: canary wave, automated health checks, automated fallback to previous firmware if error rate spikes, and SVT telemetry gating.

Attachments: maintenance plan (20270530-gpu-fw-plan.pdf) and node list (node-list-us-west3.csv). Please review the plan and flag any customer-specific constraints. I copied Acme Ops so they have visibility — they are on the large reserved pool for US-West3.

Action items:
- Aditya: confirm scheduling with Acme that the window is acceptable.
- Marcus: sanity-check the rollback playbook + backstop capacity.
- Lauren: prep the Console banner text and incident timeline template.

I'll post the finalized communication after we lock the window.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

- Rollback will reapply the previous firmware image and drain new connections while keeping the node in standby for 10m to validate health.

I'll update the playbook and attach the redline.

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Marcus, we've adjusted AZ ordering so Acme's heavy AZ (us-west3-c) will be last.

Final plan highlights (short):
- Start: 2027-06-04 23:00 UTC. Finish: 2027-06-06 06:00 UTC (rolling across AZs; us-west3-a/b first, us-west3-c last).
- Canary: 2-instance canary in us-west3-a, 15m warm-up and telemetry gating.
- Expected per-instance downtime: 30-90s. No KV evictions planned; sessions/sockets will be gracefully reconnected by the runtime within the recovery window.
- Banner: Lauren will publish a tenant-level banner 20 minutes prior to the first restart in each AZ.
- Rollback: automated reapply + 10m observation window.

Attachments: updated plan (20270530-gpu-fw-plan.pdf) and finalized node list attached.

I'll send the customer-facing notice shortly and put an incident channel on PagerDuty for the sweep. If anything else required, flag here before EOD.

Mina
